bible_quanes.question: During which period did the story of Ruth take place?
bible_quanes.explanation: There was a famine in the land.

bible_quanes.question: What was the name of Naomi's husband?
What were the names of the Moabite women Naomi's sons married?
What did Ruth say to Naomi?
bible_quanes.answer: "Whither thou goest, I will go... thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God"

bible_quanes.question: What were the names of Naomi's sons?
What did Orpah do?
What did Naomi ask to be called on her return?
When did Naomi and Ruth arrive in Bethlehem?
bible_quanes.answer: At the beginning of barley harvest

bible_quanes.question: About how long did Naomi's family live in Moab?
What did Ruth say about where she would die?
bible_quanes.answer: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried

bible_quanes.question: Who was a relative of Elimelech and a man of great wealth?
What did Ruth go out to do?
bible_quanes.explanation: In the fields after the reapers.

bible_quanes.question: How did Boaz bless Ruth?
bible_quanes.answer: The LORD recompense her work, under whose wings she was come to trust

bible_quanes.question: Until when did Ruth glean in Boaz's fields?
bible_quanes.answer: The end of barley harvest and wheat harvest

bible_quanes.question: How did Boaz greet his reapers?
What did Boaz tell Ruth to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap; when athirst, go unto the vessels and drink

bible_quanes.question: What did Ruth eat at mealtime with Boaz's reapers?
bible_quanes.answer: Of the bread, her morsel in the vinegar, and parched corn

bible_quanes.question: How much did Ruth glean on her first day?
What did Boaz tell his reapers to do for Ruth?
bible_quanes.answer: Let fall some of the handfuls of purpose for her

bible_quanes.question: What did Naomi call Boaz?
bible_quanes.answer: The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen

bible_quanes.question: Where did Naomi tell Ruth to go?
What did Ruth uncover?
What did Ruth ask Boaz to do?
bible_quanes.explanation: For he was a close relative.

bible_quanes.question: How did Boaz describe Ruth?
What was Boaz doing at the threshing floor?
What obstacle did Boaz mention?
bible_quanes.answer: There was a kinsman nearer than he

bible_quanes.question: What did Boaz give Ruth to take home?
What did Naomi tell Ruth after she returned?
bible_quanes.answer: The man will not be in rest until he have finished the thing this day

bible_quanes.question: What kindness of Ruth did Boaz praise?
bible_quanes.answer: She followed not young men, whether poor or rich

bible_quanes.question: When did Ruth leave the threshing floor?
Where did Boaz sit down to settle the matter?
Whom did Boaz marry?
What was Ruth and Boaz's son named?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was the grandfather of David.

bible_quanes.question: With whose name does the genealogy of Ruth end?
bible_quanes.explanation: The book links to Israel's king.

bible_quanes.question: How many elders did Boaz call as witnesses?
Why did the closer relative decline to redeem?
bible_quanes.answer: Lest he mar his own inheritance
bible_quanes.explanation: He passed the right to Boaz.

bible_quanes.question: How was the transaction confirmed?
bible_quanes.answer: A man plucked off his shoe and gave it to his neighbour

bible_quanes.question: What did the women say Ruth was to Naomi?
With whom does the genealogy at the end of Ruth begin?
bible_quanes.explanation: The son of Judah and Tamar.
